profile.name: Bilal Yasir
profile.title: Full Stack Developer
profile.bio: Bilal Yasir is a Full Stack Developer and Software Engineering student at The University of Chenab, Gujrat, Pakistan. He specializes in building modern SaaS platforms, ERP systems, restaurant systems, healthcare systems, AI-powered applications, and scalable business software. He combines traditional software engineering with AI-assisted development to rapidly design, prototype, and deploy production-ready applications. His focus is building software that solves real business problems while maintaining excellent UI/UX.
